name: Complexity Router
description: Route each agent turn to a model tier (complex / simple / free) based on prompt content, agent identity, and explicit markers. Runs on the before_model_resolve hook and rewrites the initial model pick; the existing model.fallbacks array in openclaw.json still provides the cascade safety net.

tiers.description: Map of tier name to model identifier (e.g. {"complex": "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6", "simple": "anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5-20251001", "free": "openrouter/openrouter/free"}).

agentDefaults.description: Map of agent id to default tier name. Used when no markers/keywords/length rule triggers.

complexKeywords.description: Lowercase substrings that force the 'complex' tier.

simpleKeywords.description: Lowercase substrings that force the 'simple' tier (only applied if no complex keyword matched).

lengthThresholds.description: Prompt character-length thresholds. Prompts shorter than 'simple' tend toward the simple tier; longer than 'complex' tend toward the complex tier.

markers.description: Explicit prompt substrings that unconditionally select a tier. Highest priority.

defaultTier.description: Fallback tier name when nothing else matches.

disabled.description: When true, the plugin loads but does not override any model selection.

tiers.label: Model tiers
tiers.help: Tier name -> model id. Tier names are referenced by agentDefaults, markers, and defaultTier. The plugin only sets the INITIAL model; the agent's model.fallbacks array still handles intra-tier cascade.

agentDefaults.label: Per-agent defaults
agentDefaults.help: When no explicit rule matches, each agent falls back to its configured tier. Agents not listed use 'defaultTier'.

markers.label: Explicit markers
markers.help: Substrings a user can include in the message to force a tier. E.g. {"!fast": "free", "!smart": "complex"}.

disabled.label: Disabled
disabled.help: Kill-switch. Flip to true to passthrough without touching any model selection.
